text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Secondary Syphilis. Although your symptoms of pruritic rash, fever, rhinorrhea, and headache could suggest viral exanthems, the specific description of a facial rash sparing the perioral area is a classic hallmark of secondary syphilis, making it the most critical diagnosis to rule out urgently.
